summary.intent: Plan and execute Phase 45 of cipher-box — a Rust-only hygiene refactor of the FUSE write-journal/replay code (7 scope items, no behavior changes) — using the GSD workflow framework's full plan→execute→verify→review pipeline.
summary.outcome: Phase 45 fully planned (6 plans, 5 waves), executed (266 tests passing, all 6 plans complete), verification passed (7/7 must-haves), and code-reviewed (2 apparent blockers proven false positives). Phase marked complete as the final roadmap phase, though ~14 unexplained uncommitted source file modifications were discovered at session end.

repo: Crate is `cipherbox-fuse` with feature flag `fuse`; cargo target is `crates/fuse`.

`publish_file_metadata` pre-existed in operations.rs:125 before Phase 45 and was already called by the live release path — the Phase 45 refactor reused it in replay rather than introducing new conflict-swallowing behavior.
The pre-refactor inline replay per-file publish swallowed conflicts identically (`Conflict { .. } => log::warn!(...), Ok`) — same semantics as `publish_file_metadata`.
The fuser/winfsp `write_generation` asymmetry (fuser bumps in `handle_write`, winfsp does not) is pre-existing platform design, not a regression.
winfsp target requires Windows-only crates (`winfsp-sys`, `windows_core`, `windows-future`, `windows_registry`) that cannot build on macOS; winfsp CI gate is Windows-only.
`fuse_abi.rs` dead-code warnings are pre-existing in the vendored fuser ABI file — unrelated to phase changes.
The GSD commit helper has a known false-negative bug: returns `commit_failed` even on successful commits; must verify via `git log`.
Phase 45 was `is_last_phase: true` — it is the final phase in the current roadmap.
5 pre-existing traceability gaps exist in REQUIREMENTS, unrelated to Phase 45.

code.finding: `write_generation += 1` bump — was at line 297 pre-refactor; still present post-refactor confirming no regression.
`write_gen` read into UploadComplete event — was at line 957 pre-refactor; still present post-refactor.
`publish_file_metadata` function pre-existed here and was used by live release path before Phase 45; conflict-swallowing behavior is not new.
IDE showed E0308 here after 45-06 executor; confirmed stale rust-analyzer cache — `cargo check --workspace` exits 0 cleanly.

workflow: rust-analyzer frequently shows stale E0308 diagnostics during or immediately after active subagent edits; always verify with `cargo check --workspace` rather than trusting IDE state.
Subagent executor reports can be thin (no explicit test/check confirmations) even on the riskiest plans — post-wave spot-checks against ground truth are necessary.
Sequential execution on feature branch was chosen over worktrees because only Wave 1 had parallelism (2 small plans); Waves 2–5 all mutate lib.rs serially, making worktree merge overhead unjustified.

Code reviewer false positives on behavior-preservation refactors require manual diff archaeology: check whether the replaced code had the same semantics as the new shared helper, and whether the behavior pre-existed.
GSD `auto_advance: true` config chains plan→execute automatically; `--no-transition` suppresses the post-execute phase transition.
The `--files` override in code-review is the highest-precedence scoping tier; SUMMARY.md extraction is the primary tier; git diff is the fallback.

friction: GSD commit helper returns `commit_failed` as a false negative even on successful commits (lint-staged output misread as error) — requires a follow-up `git log` to confirm every commit.
rust-analyzer stale diagnostics triggered two separate false-alarm investigations (45-03 and 45-06), each requiring manual `cargo check --workspace` to resolve.
Plan 45-06 executor returned a thin completion summary with no explicit test or workspace-check confirmation, requiring a full manual post-execution verification pass.
winfsp cross-build check fails on macOS by design (missing Windows-only deps) but the failure output requires careful reading to confirm it's env-only and not a code defect.

Code reviewer raised CR-01 and CR-02 as blockers (severity: critical) that both turned out to be false positives, requiring multi-step diff archaeology across pre- and post-refactor code to conclusively disprove.
~14 uncommitted source file modifications (cache.rs, dir_ops.rs, helpers.rs, inode.rs, sdk/client.rs, etc.) were discovered at session end with no explanation — left unresolved.
open_items: Investigate the ~14 unexplained uncommitted source file modifications (cache.rs, dir_ops.rs, helpers.rs, inode.rs, sdk/client.rs, etc.) found in the working tree at session end.
winfsp journal_helpers path can only be fully verified on Windows CI — macOS cannot build winfsp-sys and related Windows-only deps.
5 pre-existing REQUIREMENTS traceability gaps surfaced by the completion gate — not introduced by Phase 45 but still open.
WR-03 (minor nit): the `IpnsResolveOutcome` classifier adds `e.contains("404")` as a superset of the original `"not found"` match — benign but could be documented.
Roadmap is fully complete (`is_last_phase: true` on Phase 45) — next steps for the project are undefined.
